sketches.mechanism: Move semantics: passing a non-Copy value transfers ownership, and any later use of the old binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away cannot be offered again; the compiler remembers the absence more strictly than the speaker does.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation: an undefined value can exist in the program without crashing it unless evaluation demands it.
sketches.resonance: The wound is real, but the day continues because nothing has forced it into speech.
sketches.draft:
wound = undefined

life = 1

main = print life

sketches.mechanism: The pin operator prevents rebinding by matching against an existing value, causing failure when reality tries to rename it.
sketches.resonance: A self once fixed refuses the comfort of becoming something else.
